An intelligent herding dog. Buff for tending farm animals, but an average fighter. Stray Border Collies turn up around barns and farmsteads out in the countryside.
The most basic breed in the game, not good at anything in particular and can't kill zombies, but very charismatic.
A strong, intelligent dog. Learns Combat and Obedience quickly and gains little stress in a fight. Rare: found around police and military buildings.

A hardy sled dog, by far the breed with the most raw strength, saddlebag weight buff and keeps you warm in the cold. Average fighter. Stubborn (slower to learn Obedience), gets hungry and thirsty faster. Rare: found mostly in the cold of winter, and at pet shops and vets.
A friendly, keen-nosed gun dog, learns Hunting faster, average fighter. Its nose helps you forage and track game from farther away. Uncommon: turns up now and then in residential houses.
Sends your companion away. It keeps its training and skills, so you can tame it again later if you find it.
Give your companion a custom name.

The Caramelo is a wonderfully affectionate, charismatic mutt. Its loyal company lifts your spirits, so sadness and boredom fade faster while it's near.
Your border collie helps you with farm animals. Well cared for, the animals around you settle down, and you learn Animal Care and Farming faster.

Walking slowly and needs plenty of water. Fever comes with it!

A bold German Shepherd at your side steadies your nerves. Its fearless presence eases your panic while it stays close.
Your Golden Retriever helps you hunt. When well cared for, you spot forage from farther away and learn Foraging, Trapping and Aiming faster.

Your husky pulls its weight at your side. Well cared for, it builds your Strength faster and helps you tire less. It's a warm dog, it keeps you warm in the cold.

The %1's life. Health only falls from hunger, thirst and poisoning, and recovers slowly while well cared for.
Hunger throttles healing: a fed %1 recovers wounds faster. Hunger can kill your pet and makes loyalty drop faster.
Builds from hunger, thirst, low loyalty and FIGHTING: every strike stresses the %1. If it peaks into panic it won't fight, it only follows. How much it gains depends on the animal's genes and breed.
Like hunger, thirst throttles natural healing. Severe thirst can kill your pet and makes loyalty drop faster.

Skill at tending livestock. Levels up by caring for the animals in the zone, and gains more XP by killing zombies in it. The higher it is, the more it calms the animals.

Companion Dogs was enabled on a save that already existed.\nEverything works normally. Stray dogs are placed as you travel and parts of the map load in, so they show up in areas you have already explored as well as in new ones.\nTravel around a little and you will start finding them.

Companion Dogs could not load the dog animations.\nThis happens when the mod was not enabled in the main menu, and the dogs will render deformed.\nQuit to the main menu, make sure Companion Dogs is enabled there, then load your save again.

Less boredom when petting or sleeping next to the animal.

Percent chance per in-game day that a nearby adult male and female with the same owner breed on their own (rolled hourly). Same conditions as manual breeding: fed, loyal, healthy, off cooldown, a free dog slot, and breeding not blocked on either. Only while they are loaded near you. 0 = off.
Enables the moodle with each breed's unique buffs.
Lets pets breed. Affects server performance (low impact).
Multiplies the saddlebag's cargo capacity. 0 makes it purely cosmetic.
Allow pets to attack nearby zombies.
The pet can die of illness, hunger and thirst. Default: off.
Stash pets while owner is offline
When the owner logs out of the server, the animal leaves with them.
Default damage is 1. 0 means the pet can no longer kill zombies.
Barking, meowing and the like can attract zombies.
Animal spawn rate. Default is 1, 0 disables spawning.
Lets the pet take on caring for animals in pens. Affects server performance (low impact).
How many in-game days a pregnant pet carries before giving birth.
Base loss. A hungry or thirsty pet loses it faster.
How many in-game days a puppy takes to grow into an adult.
Maximum number of animals a player can keep bonded at once. 0 = no limit.
Daily hunger and thirst rate. Raise it and the pet eats and drinks more often.
How many hours a pet can go without protein before it turns Weak.
Enables the animal's need for protein in its diet.
Moodle whose buff reduces panic, stress, sadness and boredom and makes you tire more slowly.
How many hours the Well Rested moodle lasts.
The pets' ability to detect zombies.
Text with the pet's name. Turn off for more immersion.
Global multiplier for the pet's skills.
How much trust a pet must reach (by feeding) before it becomes your companion.
Enables the pet's tricks. Can be OP on a server.
When on, running into a pet can knock you down.
Turns hunger, thirst, loyalty and stress on or off.
Chance that the pet is born allergic to one meat for life, rolled once per pet. Default 5 percent.
The pet can pick up wounds and illnesses. Default: on.
Chance of catching the flu: rolled while the pet is starving, and for each hour beside a sick dog. Default 15 percent.
Rolled for every 6 straight hours outdoors. Going indoors resets the count. Default 1.5 percent.
Flea and tick chance per bite (percent)
Chance that each bite in a fight brings fleas or ticks. Default 0.2 percent.
Everyone starts out knowing every vet care recipe, no need for the mod's magazine.
Chance that bad food or water leaves the pet vomiting. Default 25 percent.
Percent chance that each fence the pet hops leaves it with a sprained paw. Default 0.5, 0 means never.
Worms chance per 6 h with an upset stomach (percent)
Percent chance the pet catches worms for every 6 hours with an upset stomach. Default 10 percent.
Chance that a bite the pet lands on a zombie hurts its paw. Default 0.4 percent. Each Combat level of the pet lowers it by 5 percent of this value, so at level 10 it is halved.
When on, wild animals cannot die from vehicles, fire, attacks and the like.
